candidates.title: [Feature] Energy-per-token metrics for `mlx_lm.benchmark`
candidates.snippet: `mlx_lm.benchmark` reports throughput and peak memory, but not power or energy. candidates.title: [Feature] Backward pass for gated_delta custom kernel (enables training)
candidates.snippet: ## Current behavior `mx.value_and_grad` on a model containing `gated_delta_update(use_kernel=True)`  raises: ValueError: [Primitive::vjp] Not implemented for CustomKernel  Because `qwen3_5.py` passes `use_kernel=not self.training`, training always  falls back to `gated_delta_ops` (sequential Python loop).  ## Impact (measured on M4 Pro, Qwen3.5-0.8B, seq=82, fp32) - `gated_delta_ops` (current training path): 1628 ms/step - custom kernel with backward: **387 ms/step (4.2x faster)** - vs torch-MPS
